properties.content: Semantica Explorer demo graph for Cloudera AI. Nodes and edges summarize public filings, company press releases, and major news reports. Amounts use the units stated in each source (USD unless noted). Not investment advice. Sources: https://openai.com/index/announcing-the-stargate-project/ | https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312525256310/msft-ex99_2.htm

OpenAI — developer of GPT and related frontier models; Microsoft minority shareholder; Stargate operational partner. Sources: https://openai.com/index/announcing-the-stargate-project/ | https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312525256310/msft-ex99_2.htm

Microsoft — Azure cloud; ~27% OpenAI PBC stake (as-converted, Oct 2025 recap); Mistral and Inflection partnerships. Sources: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312525256310/msft-ex99_2.htm | https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/microsoft-and-mistral-ai-announce-new-partnership-to-accelerate-ai-innovation-and-introduce-mistral-large-first-on-azure/

Anthropic — Claude models; AWS primary training partner; Google Cloud TPU customer. Sources: https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/company-news/amazon-anthropic-ai-investment | https://www.googlecloudpresscorner.com/2023-11-08-Google-Announces-Expansion-of-AI-Partnership-with-Anthropic

Amazon — parent of AWS; completed $4B Anthropic investment (Mar 2024). Sources: https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/company-news/amazon-anthropic-ai-investment | https://press.aboutamazon.com/2023/9/amazon-and-anthropic-announce-strategic-collaboration-to-advance-generative-ai

Alphabet / Google — Google Cloud; up to $2B Anthropic commitment (Oct 2023 reporting). Sources: https://www.reuters.com/technology/google-agrees-invest-up-2-bln-openai-rival-anthropic-wsj-2023-10-27/ | https://www.googlecloudpresscorner.com/2023-11-08-Google-Announces-Expansion-of-AI-Partnership-with-Anthropic
NVIDIA — AI accelerators and software; OpenAI collaborator since 2016; Stargate technology partner. Sources: https://openai.com/index/announcing-the-stargate-project/ | https://investor.nvidia.com/

Oracle — cloud infrastructure; Stargate initial equity funder and technology partner. Sources: https://openai.com/index/announcing-the-stargate-project/ | https://group.softbank/en/news/press/20250122

SoftBank Group — Stargate lead financial partner; Masa Son chairman; Arm owner. Sources: https://group.softbank/en/news/press/20250122 | https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/DCPD-202500157/html/DCPD-202500157.htm
MGX — Abu Dhabi investment vehicle; listed as initial Stargate equity funder. Sources: https://openai.com/index/announcing-the-stargate-project/

Mistral AI — French frontier lab; Azure distribution and Microsoft €15M investment (Feb 2024). Sources: https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/microsoft-and-mistral-ai-announce-new-partnership-to-accelerate-ai-innovation-and-introduce-mistral-large-first-on-azure/ | https://techcrunch.com/2024/02/27/microsoft-made-a-16-million-investment-in-mistral-ai/

Inflection AI — Pi assistant developer; 2024 licensing deal with Microsoft after staff hire. Sources: https://www.reuters.com/technology/microsoft-agreed-pay-inflection-650-mln-while-hiring-its-staff-information-2024-03-21/ | https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6719ff5f549f63039436b3c8/__Full_text_decision__.pdf

Character.AI — consumer chatbots; Aug 2024 non-exclusive Google license; Alphabet recorded $2.7B cash payment in Q3 2024 filings. Sources: https://www.reuters.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/google-hires-characterai-cofounders-licenses-its-models-information-reports-2024-08-02/ | https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204424000118/R16.htm
AMD — MI300 accelerators offered on Azure alongside NVIDIA options. Sources: https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/introducing-the-new-ai-accelerator-optimized-vms-with-amd-mi300x/
Intel — Gaudi AI accelerators available on Azure and AWS. Sources: https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/newsroom/news/intel-gaudi-3-ai-accelerator.html
Apple — Apple Intelligence platform; uses Google Cloud for some AI features per reporting. Sources: https://www.reuters.com/technology/apple-holds-talks-with-google-bring-gemini-ai-iphone-2024-03-18/

CoreWeave — GPU-focused cloud; NVIDIA-backed neocloud; OpenAI capacity supplier (reporting). Sources: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/news/coreweave-secures-2-3b-debt-financing-for-ai-infrastructure/ | https://www.reuters.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/openai-uses-nvidia-rival-chips-amid-chip-shortage-2024-03-20/

Meta — Llama models; disclosed multi-billion-dollar AI infrastructure capex. Sources: https://investor.atmeta.com/investor-news/press-release-details/2024/Meta-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2023-Results/default.aspx

xAI — Grok developer; raised billions from private investors (2024–2025 reporting). Sources: https://www.reuters.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/musks-xai-raises-6-billion-funding-valuation-24-billion-2024-05-26/

Cohere — enterprise LLMs; Oracle and NVIDIA among strategic investors (company disclosures). Sources: https://cohere.com/blog/series-d | https://www.oracle.com/news/announcement/oracle-invests-in-cohere-2023-06-08/
Databricks — data/AI platform; mutual strategic investment with NVIDIA (2023). Sources: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/about-nvidia/press-releases/2023/nvidia-databricks-strategic-partnership/
Arm Holdings — CPU IP; SoftBank-majority; Stargate initial technology partner. Sources: https://openai.com/index/announcing-the-stargate-project/
TSMC — foundry manufacturing NVIDIA and other AI accelerators. Sources: https://www.tsmc.com/static/abouttsmcaz/nasdaq_ir/annual-reports/2023/english/index.html

Stargate Project — JV announced Jan 21, 2025; up to $500B U.S. AI infrastructure intent over four years; $100B immediate deployment stated by partners. Sources: https://openai.com/index/announcing-the-stargate-project/ | https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/DCPD-202500157/html/DCPD-202500157.htm
Azure OpenAI Service — Microsoft distribution of OpenAI models to enterprise. Sources: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000095017023035122/msft-20230630.htm

Amazon Bedrock — AWS managed API for foundation models including Anthropic Claude. Sources: https://press.aboutamazon.com/2023/9/amazon-and-anthropic-announce-strategic-collaboration-to-advance-generative-ai
Founders Fund — reported participant in xAI funding rounds. Sources: https://www.reuters.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/musks-xai-raises-6-billion-funding-valuation-24-billion-2024-05-26/
Sequoia Capital — early Anthropic investor (company history). Sources: https://www.anthropic.com/news/anthropic-series-c
NVentures — NVIDIA venture arm; portfolio includes CoreWeave, Cohere, others. Sources: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/about-nvidia/ventures/

Microsoft total OpenAI funding commitments $13B ($11.8B funded as of Mar 31, 2026 per filings); ~27% OpenAI Group PBC stake after Oct 2025 recap. Sources: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312525256321/R26.htm | https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312525256310/msft-ex99_2.htm

OpenAI contracted to purchase incremental $250B of Azure services (Oct 28, 2025 agreement). Sources: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312525256321/R26.htm | https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312525256310/msft-ex99_2.htm
Azure OpenAI Service offers OpenAI models to enterprise customers. Sources: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000095017023035122/msft-20230630.htm

Amazon completed $4B total investment in Anthropic ($1.25B Sep 2023 + $2.75B Mar 2024). Sources: https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/company-news/amazon-anthropic-ai-investment | https://apnews.com/article/amazon-anthropic-investment-ai-big-tech-f5108beaa33455f331010489e03586d4

Anthropic names AWS primary cloud provider and primary training partner; uses Trainium/Inferentia. Sources: https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/aws/amazon-invests-additional-4-billion-anthropic-ai/ | https://press.aboutamazon.com/2023/9/amazon-and-anthropic-announce-strategic-collaboration-to-advance-generative-ai
Claude models available to AWS customers via Amazon Bedrock. Sources: https://press.aboutamazon.com/2023/9/amazon-and-anthropic-announce-strategic-collaboration-to-advance-generative-ai

Google agreed to invest up to $2B ($500M upfront + $1.5B over time), structured as convertible note per Anthropic spokesperson. Sources: https://www.reuters.com/technology/google-agrees-invest-up-2-bln-openai-rival-anthropic-wsj-2023-10-27/

Anthropic expanded Google Cloud partnership; uses Cloud TPU v5e for inference workloads. Sources: https://www.googlecloudpresscorner.com/2023-11-08-Google-Announces-Expansion-of-AI-Partnership-with-Anthropic

Microsoft €15M investment (converts to equity in next round) plus multi-year Azure partnership; Mistral Large on Azure. Sources: https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/microsoft-and-mistral-ai-announce-new-partnership-to-accelerate-ai-innovation-and-introduce-mistral-large-first-on-azure/ | https://techcrunch.com/2024/02/27/microsoft-made-a-16-million-investment-in-mistral-ai/

Mistral models hosted in Azure AI model catalog for enterprise customers. Sources: https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/microsoft-and-mistral-ai-announce-new-partnership-to-accelerate-ai-innovation-and-introduce-mistral-large-first-on-azure/

Microsoft agreed to pay ~$650M ($620M non-exclusive IP license + ~$30M waiver) while hiring Inflection leadership/staff. Sources: https://www.reuters.com/technology/microsoft-agreed-pay-inflection-650-mln-while-hiring-its-staff-information-2024-03-21/ | https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6719ff5f549f63039436b3c8/__Full_text_decision__.pdf

Non-exclusive LLM license; Alphabet paid $2.7B cash and canceled convertible instruments; hired co-founders. Sources: https://www.reuters.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/google-hires-characterai-cofounders-licenses-its-models-information-reports-2024-08-02/ | https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204424000118/R16.htm
Azure offers AI-optimized VMs with AMD MI300X accelerators. Sources: https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/introducing-the-new-ai-accelerator-optimized-vms-with-amd-mi300x/
Azure hosts Intel Gaudi 3 accelerator instances for AI workloads. Sources: https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/newsroom/news/intel-gaudi-3-ai-accelerator.html

Reuters reported Apple held talks to license Google Gemini for iPhone AI features (Mar 2024). Sources: https://www.reuters.com/technology/apple-holds-talks-with-google-bring-gemini-ai-iphone-2024-03-18/
SoftBank remains controlling shareholder of Arm after 2023 IPO. Sources: https://group.softbank/en/ir/financials/annual_reports

NVIDIA-Arm acquisition terminated Feb 2022 after regulatory opposition. Sources: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-and-softbank-group-announce-termination-of-nvidias-acquisition-of-arm-limited
SoftBank lead financial partner for Stargate; Masayoshi Son chairman. Sources: https://group.softbank/en/news/press/20250122 | https://openai.com/index/announcing-the-stargate-project/
OpenAI operational responsibility for Stargate infrastructure buildout. Sources: https://openai.com/index/announcing-the-stargate-project/
Oracle initial equity funder and technology partner for Stargate data centers. Sources: https://openai.com/index/announcing-the-stargate-project/
MGX listed among initial Stargate equity funders. Sources: https://openai.com/index/announcing-the-stargate-project/
NVIDIA named key initial technology partner for Stargate compute buildout. Sources: https://openai.com/index/announcing-the-stargate-project/
Microsoft named key initial technology partner for Stargate. Sources: https://openai.com/index/announcing-the-stargate-project/
Arm named key initial technology partner for Stargate. Sources: https://openai.com/index/announcing-the-stargate-project/
OpenAI cites NVIDIA collaboration dating to 2016; Stargate joint operations for compute systems. Sources: https://openai.com/index/announcing-the-stargate-project/

OpenAI used CoreWeave for additional GPU capacity amid supply constraints (Reuters reporting). Sources: https://www.reuters.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/openai-uses-nvidia-rival-chips-amid-chip-shortage-2024-03-20/

CoreWeave secured $2.3B debt financing backed by NVIDIA H100 contracts (NVIDIA press release). Sources: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/news/coreweave-secures-2-3b-debt-financing-for-ai-infrastructure/
NVentures portfolio company; NVIDIA ecosystem neocloud partner. Sources: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/about-nvidia/ventures/

xAI raised $6B series B at ~$24B valuation; Founders Fund among investors cited by Reuters. Sources: https://www.reuters.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/musks-xai-raises-6-billion-funding-valuation-24-billion-2024-05-26/

xAI Colossus and expansion clusters rely on large NVIDIA GPU deployments (company and industry reporting). Sources: https://www.reuters.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/musks-xai-raises-6-billion-funding-valuation-24-billion-2024-05-26/

Meta guided tens of billions in 2024 capex driven largely by AI infrastructure including NVIDIA GPUs. Sources: https://investor.atmeta.com/investor-news/press-release-details/2024/Meta-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2023-Results/default.aspx
Oracle invested in Cohere and partners on OCI deployment (Oracle announcement Jun 2023). Sources: https://www.oracle.com/news/announcement/oracle-invests-in-cohere-2023-06-08/
NVIDIA and Databricks announced strategic partnership and mutual investment (2023). Sources: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/about-nvidia/press-releases/2023/nvidia-databricks-strategic-partnership/
Sequoia participated in Anthropic Series C (company announcement). Sources: https://www.anthropic.com/news/anthropic-series-c
Demo edge — verify live terms via cited primary sources before business use. Sources: https://openai.com/index/announcing-the-stargate-project/
